Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football Ballon d’Or 2026: Harry Kane wins 2026 Men’s Striker of the Year award Source : JoySports 26 October 2026 11:04pm Audio By Carbonatix
Bayern Munich and England striker Harry Kane has won the 2026 Men’s Striker of the Year award at the Ballon d’Or ceremony in London after an outstanding goalscoring campaign for club and country.
The England captain received the honour on Monday, recognising his prolific performances during the 2025/26 season. Kane entered the ceremony as one of the leading contenders for the men’s Ballon d’Or after establishing himself as one of the most productive forwards in world football.
Kane scored 73 goals and made 8 assists for club and country in 65 appearances in the 2025/26 season.
The 33-year-old has continued to lead Bayern Munich’s attack since joining the German champions from Tottenham Hotspur in August 2023. His arrival in the Bundesliga marked a new chapter in his career after spending nearly two decades in English football, including his rise to become Tottenham’s all-time leading goalscorer.
Kane has also maintained his importance to England, where he serves as captain and remains a central figure in the national team's pursuit of major international honours.
His latest individual recognition comes as he challenges for the biggest prize of the evening, the men’s Ballon d’Or. Kane emerged as a leading candidate following a season in which his goalscoring record and influence for Bayern made him one of the favourites for the award.
The striker’s achievement adds another milestone to a career defined by remarkable consistency, intelligent movement and clinical finishing.
